race.comment: Wide open. OUTDRIVE (1) has more upside than most and looks close to another win. Placed at 2200m latest and has the claim and a low draw. Will be in it for a long way. MAWHERA (3) is another overdue for a win. Coming back in trip three weeks between runs but has placed only try course and distance. Yet to win but has five minors in wet ground and looks a leading chance despite the wide gate. PRINCESS PAINTON (4) was safely held fresh but has good upside and has placed second-up. Extra trip a plus and will be a sharp improver. ABERLUTELY (12) is fitter again and gets chance to find form. ZEACTION (7) is mixing form but tough to beat if near his best.
